status.summary: Active, on a three-fight losing streak, all by stoppage: Arman Tsarukyan (arm-triangle, R2, Doha, Nov 22, 2025), Benoit Saint Denis (TKO from mount, R2, UFC 325, Sydney, Jan 31, 2026 US time) and Salahdine Parnasse (TKO at 2:35 of R1, UFC Paris, Sep 5, 2026: a liver kick hurt him and punches finished it). Pro record 24-15. He is booked against Brian Ortega at lightweight at UFC Fight Night 294 in Doha on Nov 21, 2026, a 77-day turnaround that he says he asked for because the Parnasse loss left him with no serious injury. He is #14 in the UFC's media-panel rankings and not in the Meta top 15.

style.summary: A tall switch-stance kickboxer from New Zealand who fights at a high pace from range: a jab and long straights, front kicks and round kicks to the legs and body, and knees when he gets a clinch. He has real finishing ability standing and a dangerous guillotine. But he is hittable, and his last three fights ended inside the distance against an elite wrestler, a grappler and a striker.

moves.notes: Group weights (head, body, leg) each sum to 1. The engine's target split should come from fighters.json: recency-weighted landed shares are head 0.54 / body 0.24 / leg 0.21 and attempt shares are head 0.68 / body 0.18 / leg 0.14 (career landed 0.62 / 0.18 / 0.20; lightweight median landed about 0.62 / 0.22 / 0.15). So legs run well above the division and the body at or above it. Head group leans on the jab and straight from his long frame (6'0", 75-inch reach); head kicks are a small share. In the body group kicks lead, because his body-strike finish was a front kick (Puelles). Calf outweighs inside because his leg strikes come at volume from range. UFC Stats does not separate calf from thigh kicks, so that split is judgment. Knee is high (0.4) for two clinch-knee KOs (Pearson, Miller), with 8% of his landed strikes in the clinch. Spinning is near zero. These weights are analyst judgment from the bout stats; no published breakdown could be fetched in this pass.

engine_notes.note: Opponents shoot on him 7.7 times per 15 min recency-weighted (6.4 career; lightweight median about 4.2) and controlled him 261 seconds per 15 recently (132 career). His 73-77% takedown defence holds early, but against elite wrestlers it gives way over a round.

Chin and body trending down: knockdowns absorbed per 15 min rose from 0.18 career to 0.39 recency-weighted, with TKO losses to Saint Denis and Parnasse in 2026 (Parnasse hurt him with a liver kick before the punches). His KO losses outnumber the knockdowns he has absorbed (5 vs 3), because several stoppages came without a scored knockdown first.
Power: 9 knockdowns and 7 KO/TKO wins in 245.7 UFC minutes (0.55 knockdowns per 15; median about 0.31).
Submission threat from guard and front headlock persists (1.26 attempts per 15 recency-weighted; 2 each against Tsarukyan and Saint Denis), but his last submission win was in 2017.
Pace in his four five-round fights: 1.00 / 1.65 / 1.37 / 0.60 / 1.00 relative to round 1. Output peaks in rounds 2-3 and dips in round 4.
